curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the rapid-flashing beacon, then the hybrid beacon's yellow and red phases, the three beacon contrasts, and the white-cane and service-dog rule
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per beacon phase plus the three beacon contrasts and the blind-pedestrian card
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what each beacon phase requires and how to treat a likely blind pedestrian

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach that yield rules name who waits without granting the right-of-way, the crash-avoidance duty, the cyclist rule and why failure to yield matters
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on yield rules, the avoidance duty, cyclists, and the two contrasts plus the deadly-crash ranking
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what the right-of-way does and does not grant and how to treat cyclists

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach right on red and left turns, all-way stops, sidewalks and driveways, entering the road, crossings marked or not, and unsigned intersections, with their four contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per yielding rule plus the right-versus-left, all-way, road-versus-sidewalk and signed-versus-unsigned contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on who yields in each turning, stopping, driveway and crossing situation

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach which vehicles get the road, easing right, clearing an intersection first, the median exemption and the five-hundred-foot trailing gap, with the two contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards on emergency rigs, easing right, intersections and medians, the trailing gap and the two contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what to do when an emergency vehicle approaches from any position

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the trailing rules on narrow roads, the fifteen-foot stop, the oncoming amber slowdown and arm stop, the penalty, then the wide-road rules and the single lawful pass
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact cards per bus rule plus the behind-versus-ahead, narrow-versus-wide and number contrasts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on what to do behind or facing a school bus on narrow and wide roads
